title: 申请信
goal: 能说明申请意愿并用相关经历支持申请。

points.label: 明确表达申请对象与意愿
用相关经历支持胜任理由

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 申请信的内容与知识点

cards.title: 结构
rows: 开头
写明申请的岗位或活动
I am writing to apply for the museum guide position.
经历
说明与要求有关的经历
I have guided visitors at school exhibitions.
胜任理由
联系经历与岗位需要
This experience has prepared me to explain exhibits clearly.
结尾
表达联系意愿
I would welcome the chance to discuss my application.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 申请
apply for + 岗位或活动
I would like to apply for the library volunteer role.
资格
be qualified for + 岗位
I believe I am qualified for the position.
经历
have experience in + 名词或动名词
I have experience in organizing reading events.
联系
welcome the chance to + 动词
I would welcome the chance to discuss my experience.

body.p: 假定李华申请学校图书馆志愿者，工作包括整理图书和帮助读者。介绍申请意愿及相关经历。

body.box:
Apply for the library volunteer role.
Describe relevant experience.

Dear Library Team,
I am writing to apply for the library volunteer role. Last term I helped organize books for our class reading corner. I also showed younger students how to find the titles they wanted. These tasks taught me to arrange books carefully and answer questions clearly. I believe this experience would help me support readers in the school library. I would welcome the chance to discuss my application and can provide further details about my work. Thank you for considering my request.
Best regards,
Li Hua

body.p: 开头写明申请的岗位。整理图书的经历对应整理工作，帮低年级同学找书的经历对应帮助读者。结尾表达进一步联系的意愿。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 申请对象不明
I am writing about a position.
I am writing to apply for the guide position.
只有意愿
I want the role and I like it.
I want the role and have guided school visitors.
经历无关
I enjoy music.（申请整理图书）
I arranged books for our class library.
缺少联系
I am qualified.（未给依据）
I have guided visitors, so I can explain exhibits clearly.

groups.text: 假定李华申请校艺术节接待志愿者，工作包括引导来宾。

options: I would like to apply for the reception role.
I would like to visit the art festival with my classmates.
I helped visitors at the art festival.
I welcomed the festival reception team.
items.why: apply for the reception role 明确申请接待岗位。

options: I displayed my paintings at the festival.
I showed guests to rooms at a school event.
I visited the festival with my classmates and teachers.
I watched guests enter the school hall.
items.why: 接待工作包括引导来宾。第二项带客人去房间，正是引导来宾的经历。

items.stem: State an application for a club position.
items.why: would like to apply for 后接申请的岗位。

items.stem: Describe experience organizing a reading event.
items.why: experience in 后接动名词，说明组织读书活动的经历。

groups.text: 假定李华申请学校科学展讲解员，需要说明展品。

options: I am applying for the exhibition guide position.
I am attending the exhibition as a visitor with my classmates.
I am describing an exhibition guide's work.
I am inviting a guide to the exhibition.
items.why: applying for 明确表示申请讲解员岗位。

items.stem: Which experience best supports the application?
options: I collected exhibition tickets for my class.
I explained science models to visiting students.
I visited a science exhibition last month.
I read about the exhibition with my class.
items.why: 讲解员要说明展品。第二项是向来访学生讲解科学模型的经历，与这项工作直接对应。

groups.text: 假定李华申请英语社团活动组织者，工作包括安排讨论。

items.stem: Which sentence states the intended role?
options: I enjoyed the club's last discussion.
I attended an English club meeting.
I wish to apply for the organizer role.
I discussed the organizer's role with friends at the meeting.
items.why: apply for the organizer role 指明申请组织者岗位。

options: I read about several English clubs and their members.
I attended a discussion as a guest.
I enjoyed listening to club members.
I arranged weekly discussions for my class.
items.why: 组织者的工作包括安排讨论。第四项是为班级安排每周讨论的经历，与这项工作相符。

items.stem: Express an application for a volunteer role.
items.why: am writing to apply for 表达写信申请的目的。
experience in helping 表示帮助读者的经历。

items.stem: Express interest in applying for a camp position.
items.why: would like to apply for 指明申请意愿和对象。

items.stem: Connect guide experience to explaining exhibits.
items.why: has prepared me to explain 将经历与讲解工作联系起来。
